sources.title: User-supplied extracted WWE 2K22 reference tree
sources.limitations: This local tree is for developer byte and path verification only. It must not be bundled or required from end users.

facts.fact: The inspected install contains WWE2K22_x64.exe, oo2core_9_win64.dll, and bakedfile00.cak through bakedfile07.cak.
All eight installed CAKs begin with FDIR, version 0x0308, and flags 0xC001.
facts.limitations: No catalog offsets, record layout, compression flags, or writable behavior are claimed.

facts.fact: The current AuroraForge NT100 WWE 2K20 and WWE 2K26 readers both reject the inspected WWE 2K22 bakedfile00.cak catalog.
facts.limitations: Shared safety helpers may still be reusable, but neither version-specific parser is compatible as implemented.

facts.fact: The supplied extracted Root contains 262,956 files and identifies stream //wwe22/build, build 1882, changelist 1101457.
facts.limitations: The reference tree does not reveal encrypted CAK catalog keys and cannot by itself validate an archive reader.
